'''Gustavo E. Romero''' is a professor of Relativistic Astrophysics at the [[University of La Plata]] in Argentina. In addition to his academic role, he serves as a Superior Researcher of the National Research Council of Argentina.<ref>{{cite web |title=National Research Council of Argentina |url=https://www.conicet.gov.ar/ |website=conicet.gov |language=es}}</ref> Romero also holds the position of Director of the [[Argentine Institute of Radio Astronomy]] (IAR). Additionally, Romero has previously served as President of the Argentine Astronomical Society<ref>{{cite web |title=Argentine Astronomical Society |url=http://www.astronomiaargentina.org.ar/ |website=astronomiaargentina.org.ar |language=es}}</ref> and is currently the leader of the GARRA research group<ref>{{cite web |title=GARRA |url=https://garra.iar.unlp.edu.ar/ |website=GRUPO DE ASTROFÍSICA RELATIVISTA Y RADIOASTRONOMÍA}}</ref> and a [[Helmholtz Association of German Research Centres|Helmholtz International Fellow]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Helmholtz International Fellow Award für weitere fünf Wissenschaftler |url=https://www.helmholtz.de/aktuell/presseinformationen/artikel/artikeldetail/helmholtz_international_fellow_award_fuer_weitere_fuenf_wissenschaftler-1/ |website=Helmholtz.de |language=de |access-date=2019-10-23 |archive-date=2019-10-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022051308/https://www.helmholtz.de/aktuell/presseinformationen/artikel/artikeldetail/helmholtz_international_fellow_award_fuer_weitere_fuenf_wissenschaftler-1/ }}</ref> 

For his professional accomplishments, Romero has been honored with several notable awards  in scientific research, including an award from the Argentine Academy of Sciences,<ref>{{cite web |title=Award of the Argentine Academy of Sciences |date=8 June 2020 |url=https://www.anc-argentina.org.ar/en/actividades/premios-anc/ganadores-premios-academia-nacional-de-ciencias-edicion-2003/|language=es}}</ref> the [[Bernardo Houssay Award|Houssay Prize]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Houssay Prize |date=9 April 2019 |url=https://www.argentina.gob.ar/ciencia/ganadores/premios-houssay-2009|language=es}}</ref> and the [[Konex Award]] 2023.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-05-15|author=Fundación Konex|date=2 May 2023|language=spanish|title=Premios Konex 2023: Ciencia y Tecnología. Ya se conocen los Diplomas al Mérito|url=https://www.fundacionkonex.org/n1452-premios-konex-2023-ciencia-y-tecnologia-ya-se-conocen-los-diplomas-al-merito|website=fundacionkonex.org}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

==Research work==
Romero has worked extensively on gamma-ray, neutrino and cosmic-ray astrophysics, black holes, and [[scientific philosophy (metaphilosophy)|scientific philosophy]]. He is well known for his investigations of blazars, microquasars, and unidentified gamma-ray sources.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Romero |first1=Gustavo E. |title=Microquasars and Gamma-ray Sources |journal=Chinese Journal of Astronomy and Astrophysics |volume=5 |pages=110–120 |language=en |doi=10.1088/1009-9271/5/S1/110 |date=December 2005|hdl=11336/29696 |s2cid=15373413 |hdl-access=free |arxiv=astro-ph/0407461 }}</ref> His research has received around 11000 citations in the academic literature,<ref>{{cite web |title=Google Scholar |url=https://scholar.google.com.ar/citations?user=c7nIsBoAAAAJ&hl=en|language=en}}</ref> making him one of the most cited scientists of Argentina.<ref>{{cite web |title=Webometrics |url=http://www.webometrics.info/es/node/93 |website=www.webometrics.info}}</ref>

In the field of philosophy, he has contributed with research on [[Supertask]], spacetime ontology,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Romero |first1=Gustavo E. |title=On the Ontology of Spacetime: Substantivalism, Relationism, Eternalism, and Emergence |journal=Foundations of Science |volume=22 |pages=141–159 |language=en |doi=10.1007/s10699-015-9476-1|date=2017|hdl=11336/35354 |s2cid=124842203 |hdl-access=free |arxiv=1509.08981 }}</ref> and aesthetics.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Romero |first1=Gustavo E. |title=Outline of a Theory of Scientific Aesthetics |journal=Foundations of Science |volume=23 |pages=795–807 |language=en |doi=10.1007/s10699-018-9551-5|date=2018 |issue=4 |s2cid=126062553 |url=https://philpapers.org/rec/ROMOOA-2 |hdl=11336/82421 |hdl-access=free }}</ref> Romero is usually considered a disciple of the Argentine-Canadian philosopher and physicist Mario Bunge.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Bunge |first1=Mario |title=Between Two Worlds Memoirs of a Philosopher-Scientist |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-29251-9|date=2016 |isbn=978-3-319-29250-2 }}</ref>
